title: Answer with adj on and no decision key must proceed

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Found in the S28 human check. run.answer with adj on refuses an empty By even when the pending question has no decision key, although FileAnswer files nothing then (internal/engine/answer_adj.go:18-20 returns before its own By check). The TUI never sends adj without a key (internal/tui/model.go:1226-1227) and `ork answer` never sends adj (internal/cli/run.go:196-201), so only a direct daemon caller hits it; the daemon should still match the engine.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/daemon/runs.go` (ownerRun, the MethodRunAnswer case near :859-862): refuse an empty p.By only when rec.Pending.Key is non-empty.
- `internal/daemon/answer_adj_test.go` (TestAnswerWithoutAdjDecidedByIsRefusedWithoutKey near :305): rename and invert.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- TestAnswerWithAdjAndNoKeyProceedsWithoutDecidedBy (replaces TestAnswerWithoutAdjDecidedByIsRefusedWithoutKey): adj on, By empty, no decision key; the answer succeeds, the role resumes (the run leaves paused, like TestStructuredOptionFilesAdjTitleAndDecisionText), the question records the answer and no adj command is called.
- TestAnswerWithoutAdjDecidedByIsRefused (:147, keyed) stays unchanged and passing.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Tests first: rewrite the no-key test as above and watch it fail on the ADJ_DECIDED_BY refusal.
2. In the MethodRunAnswer case, change the guard to `p.Adj && rec.Pending.Key != "" && strings.TrimSpace(p.By) == ""` (rec.Pending is non-nil there; the check above ensures it).
3. internal/engine/answer_adj.go already returns before its By check when the key is empty; leave it.
4. docs/dashboard.md:616-618 says filing requires ADJ_DECIDED_BY; no change needed, since a keyless question cannot file.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- go test -race -count=1 ./internal/daemon ./internal/engine ./internal/tui
- a keyed answer without ADJ_DECIDED_BY is still refused (TestAnswerWithoutAdjDecidedByIsRefused)
- go test -race -count=1 ./...
- go vet ./...
- gofmt -l .
- slicer check
- adj lint
